findings.priority_reason: Adds support for SOCKS5 proxy domain resolution (socks5h), expanding proxy configuration capabilities.
findings.title: Add support for SOCKS5 proxy domain resolution scheme
findings.before: The client only allowed 'http', 'https', and 'socks5' schemes, with the latter requiring client-side DNS resolution.
findings.after: The client additionally supports the 'socks5h' scheme, which allows remote DNS resolution through the proxy server.
findings.scenario: Configure a proxy with a remote DNS resolution scheme
findings.example_before: proxy_url = "socks5://my-proxy.com:1080"; client = httpx.Client(proxy=proxy_url) # Raises ValueError if scheme is unknown or requires 'socks5h'
findings.example_after: proxy_url = "socks5h://my-proxy.com:1080"; client = httpx.Client(proxy=proxy_url) # Successfully configures proxy for remote resolution
findings.potential_impact: Users can now route DNS lookups through SOCKS5 proxies, improving privacy or connectivity in segmented networks.
findings.review_question: Does the downstream transport implementation for 'socks5h' correctly propagate the remote DNS flag to the underlying socksio library?
